These are working interactive artifacts, shared by link for collaborators. Each
runs entirely in the browser — nothing to install, no server. **Tapping the link
on a phone works** (an emailed `.html` file does not, because mail apps block the
JavaScript that draws the artifact).

## Ketones × cognition — the re-pool story, then an explorer

*Source: `fresh_evidence/reports/viewer/` · engine: MA re-pool (`R/repool.R`) +
`interactive-storytelling` · from the Bonnechère 2026 meta-analysis of 29 RCTs.*

It narrates how a published pooled effect (SMD **0.29**) holds up under scrutiny —
a mis-pooled variance the random-effects model absorbs, then risk-of-bias,
endpoint, and chronic-dosing filters — and lands in a live explorer where you
slice the 29 trials yourself and watch the pool re-form.

```{=html}
<iframe id="ketonesFrame" class="artifact-frame"
        src="ketones-repool.html" title="Ketones × cognition — re-pool story → explorer"
        style="width:100%;border:1px solid #eee8df;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf8;height:620px"
        scrolling="yes" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<p style="margin:.5rem 0 0;font-size:.9rem">
  <a href="ketones-repool.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open web version full-screen ↗</a>
  &nbsp;·&nbsp;

</p>

(function(){
  var f=document.getElementById("ketonesFrame");
  function fit(){ try{ var d=f.contentDocument; if(d&&d.body){ f.style.height=(d.body.scrollHeight+8)+"px"; } }catch(e){} }
  f.addEventListener("load",function(){ fit(); setTimeout(fit,500); });

})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Web vs mobile.** The embed above and the *web* link show the full two-column
layout (chart + rail). The *mobile* link is a phone-first rendition — narration
capped to two lines, the meta-analysis and filters condensed to compact tap
targets, the forest cropped to fit. Share whichever matches how your collaborator
will open it; both are the same underlying artifact.
:::

## Visual primitives — the FRESH animation library

*Source: `fresh_radar/visual_primitives/` (registry of 62 skill-paired primitives) · these
seven are the extracted, playable animations, inlined to run standalone.*

Reusable animation + chart building blocks pulled from across the portfolio (diet signature,
well-being wheel, the reveal/climb engines). These are **desktop-oriented** animations — the
embeds and links below are the web rendition; tap **Open ↗** to run one full-screen.

### Radar climb engine — the signature grows commitment-by-commitment

A signature radar that grows as commitments land: a cursor walks from today to the full plan,
the polygon tweens between shapes, a scoreboard ticks the composite score up, a dashed ghost
shows the prior state, and pulsing halos mark the axes each commitment moved.

```{=html}
<iframe class="artifact-frame" src="vp-radar-climb-engine.html" title="Radar climb engine" loading="lazy"
  style="width:100%;border:1px solid #eee8df;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf8;height:560px"></iframe>
<p style="margin:.4rem 0 0;font-size:.9rem"><a href="vp-radar-climb-engine.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open ↗</a></p>
```

### Day zoom — relive, then climb

A single day's radar that first *relives* the day (assembles the polygon food-by-food from an
empty plate, honoring axis polarity), reveals the as-eaten score, then *climbs* as swaps land
(white rice → quinoa), with per-swap ghost + green/red halos, a scoreboard ticking 42 → 67, and
a scrubbable swap rail.

```{=html}
<iframe class="artifact-frame" src="vp-day-zoom-relive-climb.html" title="Day zoom — relive & climb" loading="lazy"
  style="width:100%;border:1px solid #eee8df;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf8;height:560px"></iframe>
<p style="margin:.4rem 0 0;font-size:.9rem"><a href="vp-day-zoom-relive-climb.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open ↗</a></p>
```

### FRESH-Day week reveal

A guided week explorer: day dots land left-to-right and hold, the average line connects, the
toughest day turns around in gold, every day's potential ring grows in, and it ends on a
click-any-day CTA before settling to a canonical resting state with Replay.

```{=html}
<iframe class="artifact-frame" src="vp-freshday-week-reveal.html" title="FRESH-Day week reveal" loading="lazy"
  style="width:100%;border:1px solid #eee8df;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf8;height:560px"></iframe>
<p style="margin:.4rem 0 0;font-size:.9rem"><a href="vp-freshday-week-reveal.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open ↗</a></p>
```

### Reach & plateau morph

A "watch it plateau" story: the signature morphs out toward its comfort ceiling, each "wall"
axis is walked one at a time and stalls short of target, then breakthrough segments draw in
where a new food actually clears the wall — each beat captioned.

### Signature radar (static primitive)

The diet "signature" as a smooth closed spline polygon over an evolving set of nutrient +
food-group axes (encourage-top / limit-bottom), with per-axis emoji labels, an uncertainty
band, green fresh-axis halos, and an optional gold dashed food-overlay polygon.

```{=html}
<iframe class="artifact-frame" src="vp-signature-radar.html" title="Signature radar" loading="lazy"

```

### Well-being domain panel

The LifeScore / Rhythm well-being wheel: a 6-domain radar (Sleep, Diet, Activity, Mind,
Self-Care, Social) drawn as a filled spline polygon with a click-to-detail observer and a
"See the future" toggle that morphs the polygon to a projected state.
